description: This file defines the SubTotal class as part of the OpenCart extension for calculating the subtotal in the shopping cart total calculation. It extends the core Model class and implements the getTotal method to add the subtotal value to the totals array.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: A class responsible for calculating and adding the shopping cart subtotal to the total calculations in OpenCart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal of the cart, adds it to the totals array, and updates the total amount.
